name: EN
note: Enable and programmable input undervoltage lockout (EN/UVLO)

name: GND
note: Power ground and signal ground (one net)

name: ISP
note: Current sense amplifier positive input (supply side of the shunt)

name: ISN
note: Current sense amplifier negative input (load side of the shunt)

name: FB_INT
note: Fault indicator output with internal feedback; feedback divider tap with external feedback

name: CDC
note: Voltage proportional to the sensed output current (cable droop compensation)

name: EXTVCC
note: VCC source select: high = internal LDO, low = external 5 V
